beats.text: In East Timor, 15.6% of working women hire employees. In the USA, it is 1.2%.
That gives East Timor 13 times what the USA has.
At the world's lowest end, Pakistan has just 0.1%.
Djibouti sits near the top with 14.6%, while Azerbaijan has 13.1%.
Big economies lag behind: China has 2.7%, Germany 2%, the UK 0.9%, and India 0.6%.
Nigeria stands out in Africa, where 10.4% of working women hire staff.
How many working women hire employees in your country?
